cohort: The study included 118,459 primiparous women from the Medical Birth Registry of Norway between 2013 and 2017.
finding: Maternal origin and pre-pregnancy BMI are significantly associated with the risk of both emergency and elective caesarean section.
mod_finding: Women from Sub-Saharan Africa had more than two times the risk of emergency caesarean section compared to women originating from Norway, regardless of pre-pregnancy BMI.
